title: USDCx becomes available on Cardano through Circle xReserve
description: Circle announced USDCx on Cardano as a dollar-denominated stablecoin issued by a decentralized protocol on Cardano and fully backed by USDC held in Circle xReserve.
notes: Circle publishes the Cardano mainnet asset address in the launch source.

title: USDCx becomes available on Canton through Circle xReserve
description: Circle announced Canton as the first blockchain connected to xReserve, with USDCx created by a decentralized protocol on Canton and backed through USDC deposited to xReserve.
notes: Circle publishes the Canton mainnet InstrumentId identity.

title: USDCx becomes available on Stacks through Circle xReserve
description: Circle announced Stacks USDCx as a dollar-denominated stablecoin issued by Stacks and fully backed by USDC held in Circle xReserve.
notes: Circle publishes the Stacks mainnet asset address.

title: Circle records Aleo mainnet USDCx support through xReserve
description: Circle xReserve release notes record Aleo mainnet and testnet support for USDCx on 2026-01-27.
notes: Exact Aleo mainnet token identity remains unresolved and is not inferred.

title: Revolut announces phased EURR rollout
description: Revolut announced phased testing of euro-backed EURR, issued by Bridge Building S.A., launching on Ethereum for eligible customers in Denmark, Poland and Portugal during August 2026.
notes: The article date records the rollout announcement; exact first issuance/availability day is not asserted from the reviewed source.
